fields.narrative_intro: *A mischievous person and a deranged person discuss the Z-Library paper's nonexistent citation at a live trivia night.*
fields.panel1:
[setup]
MISCHIEVOUS PERSON: "Final question: cite one real source from the Z-Library paper."
DERANGED PERSON: "Easy: the 2021 TorrentFreak article, 'Publishers continue crackdown on shadow libraries.'"
fields.panel2:
[build]
MISCHIEVOUS PERSON: "Excellent answer. TorrentFreak says that article never existed."
DERANGED PERSON: "Then my confidence is already peer-reviewed."
fields.panel3:
[pivot]
MISCHIEVOUS PERSON: "At least ten of forty-four references are unlocatable."
DERANGED PERSON: "Consensus sifted literature; ChatGPT polished prose."
fields.panel4:
[silent reaction]
[Visual: The host flips four identical answer sheets, each citing the nonexistent TorrentFreak article; every contestant smiles mechanically.]
fields.panel5:
[punch]
MISCHIEVOUS PERSON: "Pangram rated the abstract and conclusion 100% AI."
DERANGED PERSON: "I invented a citation nobody can find. That's either human or peer-reviewed."
fields.panel6:
[button]
[Visual: A Taylor & Francis investigator stamps the trophy "CORRECTION OR RETRACTION?"; its plaque cites the nonexistent article.]

narrative_summary: At trivia night, a confidently hallucinated citation survives every test until Taylor & Francis investigates the trophy.
rationale: Candidate 3 best converts the story’s failed verification into a genuine escalation: confidence itself becomes “peer-reviewed,” culminating in a sharper human-versus-AI punchline. The trivia structure and concrete details support the joke without merely repeating that the citation is missing.
story_title: AI-Assisted Paper on Z-Library Cites a TorrentFreak Article That Doesn't Exist
place: at a live trivia night where every contestant is suspected of being an AI bot
hat_pair: foam soft-serve ice cream cone hat with a plastic wafer biscuit sticking out the top
astronaut helmet with a bobblehead glued to the visor
